from grades import load_grades, ROWS
from register import GradeBook


def test_total_after_add():
    rows = list(load_grades())
    book = GradeBook()
    book.add(rows[0])
    assert book.total() == ROWS[0][1]
    book.add(rows[1])
    assert book.total() == ROWS[0][1] + ROWS[1][1]


def test_total_once():
    book = GradeBook()
    for x in load_grades():
        book.add(x)
    assert book.total() == sum(v for _, v in ROWS)

    book = GradeBook()
    running = 0
    for x in load_grades():
        book.add(x)
        running += x.score
        assert book.total() == running
